name: Google Cedar Rapids

timeline.event: Building 1 cooling towers and generators starting to be put in place. There's a foundation for Building 2 and 3.
About half of Building 1 generators are in place. Building 2 roofing has started - about where Google Omaha Building 3 was on 2025-03-16.

Building 1's generators are still only about halfway in place, and ~1/2 the cooling towers are still under construction. Building 2 roofing has been completed, and visible foundations have been built for cooling towers and generators.
Building 1 is operational. There is still work to be done since April, and Q4 2026 operational estimate was based on visible progress then.
Building 2 is operational. Based on Google Omaha Building 3 taking about 14 months from starting the roof to operation.
Building 3 is operational. Earlier satellite images suggest it was about 3 months behind Building 2.

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: Google Cedar Rapids: current power 0 MW; owner Google.

explain: Google Cedar Rapids is an under-construction AI data center in IA, IA, owned by google. Epoch AI estimates it draws 0 MW today and 314 MW when finished.
